items.scope: Founder-prioritized new community article, documented origins versus traditions; distinguish military service, caste identities and living heritage.

items.title: Khandayat: land, service and community history
items.scope: How Khandayat identity formed and changed: dated evidence, inherited service and cultivation, regional distinctions and origin traditions. No single-purpose caste creation, innate rank or automatic Paika equivalence.

items.title: Chasa: cultivation and community history
items.scope: Chasa: cultivation as work and community identity, dated social formation, regional distinctions and origin traditions. Distinguish occupational word from specific communities and avoid universal Khandayat equivalence.

items.title: Tanti: weaving and community histories
items.scope: Tanti histories in Odisha: weaving occupation and community names, regional distinctions, documented formation versus origin accounts, inherited craft and change. Do not merge all weaving communities or treat administrative grouping as ancestry.

items.title: Bhulia: weaving and community history
items.scope: Bhulia community histories in Odisha: dated weaving records, migration and origin traditions distinguished from demonstrated ancestry, regional craft practice and social change. Administrative Bhuliya spelling is a research lead, not proof of aliases or all-weaver equivalence.

items.title: Kumbhara: pottery and community histories
items.scope: Kumbhara community histories in Odisha: pottery, origin traditions versus documented formation, local institutions and changing work. Do not conflate all potters, grouped administrative names or Kandha-Kumbhar with one ancestry.

items.title: Karana: writing, offices and community history
items.scope: Karana histories in Odisha: community formation, scribal work and offices, documented origins versus traditions, regional institutions and social change. Distinguish community, office/title and similar names; no automatic Kayastha or Karanam equivalence or hereditary rank.

items.title: Kaibarta: fishing boat work and community history
items.scope: Kaibarta community histories in Odisha: fishing, boat work, regional names and origin traditions. Establish precise source-specific relationships with Keuta/Keot labels; never infer universal aliases or that all fishers form one caste.

items.title: Odia Cultural Identity and Pride
items.scope: Constructive cultural essay grounded in documented names, regional practices, craft and transmission; no unsupported decline claims.

items.title: Nolia coastal community history
items.scope: Nolia community histories on the Odisha coast: source-specific naming, movement and settlement, maritime work and cultural transmission. Establish evidence rather than assume a single creation event or equate all coastal fishers.

items.title: Kansari community history
items.scope: Kansari community history: regional naming, workshop inheritance, documented changes and origin traditions; no caste inferred from craft or surname.

items.title: Gopala regional community history
items.scope: Gopala and Gauda regional community history: cattle work, named local practices, origin traditions and changing livelihoods; administrative groupings are not universal aliases.

items.title: Chitrakara regional community history
items.scope: Chitrakara regional community history: documented service, learning and changing work, with origin traditions distinguished from formation evidence and painting occupation from community identity.

items.title: Teli regional community history
items.scope: Teli regional community history: oil work, transport, naming and changing livelihoods, with origins distinguished from occupational accounts.

items.title: Bhandari regional community history
items.scope: Bhandari regional community history: inherited service, ritual participation, names and changing work; occupational explanations distinguished from formation evidence.

items.title: Mali regional community history
